name: Honda K-Series PCV Adapter - 10AN
title: Honda K-Series PCV Adapter - 10AN
description:
Founded in 2008, ColorFittings is an industry leader in premium automotive, marine, and aviation plumbing products. 

Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, our products are designed for all flavors of motorsports. 

ColorFittings products are carefully machined from 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum and finished with our proprietary polish and anodizing process. 

AN to Metric adapter or union fittings allow you to connect two female fitting points together, one metric and one AN flare end side. 

These Adapters make a perfect fit and seal to our AN Fittings, which are specifically designed for use with our e85 and race-fuel compatible Nylon Braided Hoses.

For a hassle-free installation process, we strongly recommend using our Fitting Assembly Tools. Please use our Reference Video for proper installation procedures.
